description: Dated, verified Tanzania observations stored as source and claim records (schemas/records.schema.json $defs source and claim). Refreshable examples of the record discipline, not a fact pack. Check each review_condition before use; re-verify material figures at their source.
verified_by: Build verification, 2026-09-17: documents downloaded and tables inspected at the stated locators; World Bank values retrieved from the Indicators API.

sources.title: National Consumer Price Index (NCPI) for August 2026
sources.locator: p.2, Table 1: rows 'TOTAL - ALL ITEMS INDEX' and '7 Transport', 12-month percentage change column; p.1 sections 1.1-1.2 for scope and base
sources.geography: Tanzania Mainland (prices collected in the 26 mainland regional headquarters)
sources.population_sample: Price collection in 26 mainland regional headquarters; weights from Household Budget Survey 2017/18 urban and rural households
sources.method: Consumer price index, base period average Jan-Dec 2020 = 100
sources.limitations: Mainland only (Zanzibar CPI published separately by OCGS). Prices collected in urban regional headquarters. Measures household consumer prices, not any firm's input costs. Page 4 text contains a typo for the July index (125.85; Table 1 gives 124.85).

lineage.note: Figures cross-checked against the NBS XLS summary for the same release

sources.review_condition: Superseded by the next monthly NCPI release (scheduled 2026-10-08)

sources.locator: News page dated 2026-09-07, annual inflation figure in summary text
sources.population_sample: unknown: price collection coverage not stated on the news page
sources.method: Consumer price index (method details in the full release PDF, not inspected)
sources.limitations: News summary only; full release PDF not inspected. Not comparable to Mainland NCPI without checking basket, weights and base.
sources.review_condition: Superseded by the next monthly Zanzibar CPI release

sources.title: World Development Indicators / Global Findex: Account ownership (FX.OWN.TOTL.ZS), Tanzania

claims.statement: Annual headline inflation measured by the Mainland NCPI was 4.3% in August 2026 (4.2% in July 2026).

basis.locator: p.2 Table 1, 'TOTAL - ALL ITEMS INDEX', 12-month change; p.2 section 2.1

claims.units_denominator: % change in the all-items index over 12 months

confidence.reason: Official release, direct measure, matches NBS XLS summary

market_applicability.reason: Direct official measure for this scope; does not cover Zanzibar

claims.limitations: Does not establish any firm's cost exposure or a category's price changes

claims.statement: Transport division prices rose 13.8% over the 12 months to August 2026 in the Mainland NCPI; transport carries a weight of 14.1 in the index.

basis.locator: p.2 Table 1, row '7 Transport' (weight 14.1; index 119.69 Aug 2025, 136.18 Aug 2026)

claims.units_denominator: % change in the transport division index over 12 months

market_applicability.reason: Direct official measure for this scope

claims.limitations: Household transport prices (fares, fuel, vehicles), not freight or distribution costs of a specific business

claims.statement: Zanzibar annual inflation was reported at 5.57% for August 2026.
claims.units_denominator: % change in Zanzibar CPI over 12 months

confidence.reason: Official source but taken from the news summary; full release not inspected

claims.limitations: Basket, weights and coverage not checked; not directly comparable with Mainland NCPI

claims.statement: TCRA reported 116,952,295 telecom subscriptions at end-June 2026 (mobile 116,850,926; fixed 101,369), of which 1,233,467 were machine-to-machine SIMs.
claims.units_denominator: Subscriptions (SIMs used at least once in 90 days, plus fixed lines)

confidence.reason: Regulator's administrative data for exactly this measure

market_applicability.scope: United Republic of Tanzania, telecom subscriptions (not people)

claims.limitations: Subscriptions, not unique people or households

claims.statement: TCRA reported 62,793,986 internet subscriptions at end-June 2026 (mobile wireless 62,203,801; fixed wireless 391,488; fixed wired 198,697).

confidence.reason: Regulator's administrative data for exactly this measure

market_applicability.scope: United Republic of Tanzania, internet subscriptions (not users)

claims.limitations: Subscriptions, not unique internet users; says nothing about usage intensity or device type

claims.statement: TCRA defines a subscription as a SIM used at least once for voice, SMS or data in the past 90 days, and reports penetration of 167.0% (telecom) and 89.7% (internet) without stating the population denominator.

basis.locator: Glossary p.7-8; snapshot p.10; Figure 1.1.4.1 p.17; p.35

confidence.reason: Definitions and figures read directly from the report

claims.limitations: Denominator not stated; implied denominator is an inference, not a reported figure

claims.statement: The World Bank estimates Tanzania's total population in 2025 at 70,545,865.

confidence.reason: Authoritative compiler but a modelled estimate between censuses

market_applicability.scope: United Republic of Tanzania, total population

claims.limitations: Estimate; compare with NBS projections when precision matters

claims.statement: Telecom subscription counts cannot be read as unique people or audience reach: end-June 2026 subscriptions (about 117.0 million) exceed the estimated 2025 total population (about 70.5 million) of all ages.

basis.reasoning: A count larger than the whole population must include multiple subscriptions per person and non-person subscriptions (machine-to-machine SIMs are reported separately); the 90-day activity definition also counts intermittently used SIMs.

confidence.reason: Follows arithmetically from two direct measures and the stated definition

market_applicability.reason: Based on local regulator and population data

claims.limitations: Does not estimate the number of unique mobile users; that requires survey or operator unique-user data
claims.review_condition: When either input record is superseded

claims.statement: Global Findex estimates that 59.8% of adults aged 15+ in Tanzania had an account at a financial institution or personally used a mobile money service in 2024 (52.4% in 2021).

confidence.reason: Direct survey measure; sampling error not shown in the API; definition combines account types

claims.limitations: National survey estimate; does not describe specific regions, segments or active usage
